question: Should production repair automerge adopt this Administration-scoped ruleset verifier and receipt-bound four-stage publication flow?
rationale: The code is internally consistent, but granting a new App permission and changing the trusted production mutation boundary require explicit maintainer authorization.

options.title: Approve staged rollout
options.body: Land the code with merge gates disabled, run controlled blocked and successful paths, then grant and enable the verifier after reviewing the evidence.

options.title: Keep automerge disabled
options.body: Use the staged-proof infrastructure while deferring Administration access and merge-capable publication.

options.title: Split privileged finalization
options.body: Separate ruleset verification and token-only mutation into a narrower follow-up if maintainers want independent landing decisions.

recommendation.title: Approve staged rollout
recommendation.body: Land the code with merge gates disabled, run controlled blocked and successful paths, then grant and enable the verifier after reviewing the evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns both the current-main baseline and the exact implementation and is best positioned to coordinate the controlled rollout with the shared historical owner.
